anchor.quote: The object of this treatise is to enlighten a religious man who has been trained to believe in the truth of our holy Law, who conscientiously fulfils his moral and religious duties, and at the same time has been successful in his philosophical studies.

body: Maimonides' project of reconciling Aristotelian philosophy with Jewish scripture, written in Judaeo-Arabic in Ayyubid Cairo. It shaped not only Jewish thought but, through Latin translation, the scholasticism of Aquinas.
